correctness.rationale: Automorphisms have P monomial 2x2 linear part, Q induced squares, and arbitrary socle B; dimension fixed equals 1+dim ker(P−I)+dim ker(Q−I)−rank(B|ker(P−I) modulo im(Q−I)). Enumerating possible (r,s) for diagonal and anti-diagonal P distinguishes ±1 in odd characteristic from characteristic two, and counting finite s×r matrix ranks yields coefficients and Burnside totals. Boundary q=2 and odd q=3 show nonnegative counts, all counts sum to group order.
